title: The dotted quarter note
summary: A beat and a half, then a quick note.

steps.title: A beat and a half
text: A dot adds half again, so a **dotted quarter note** lasts a beat and a half. A single eighth note nearly always follows it.
Count **1 2 and**: the eighth lands on the **and** of 2.

steps.title: Think of a tie
text: It is the same as a quarter note tied to an eighth. If the rhythm feels slippery, count every eighth, **1 and 2 and**, and play on 1 and on the second **and**.

steps.title: Long, short
text: Each bar starts with the dotted rhythm.

steps.title: Dotted quarters
text: Keep counting the eighths in your head.
